profile_creators_meta_description: The people behind Sons of the Forest mods and builds: downloads, followers, tiers and their best-known work. Follow a creator to hear about new releases.
profile_creators_intro: The survivors who make the island’s mods and builds. Follow them to get a signal when they release something new.
profile_creators_empty_description: Nobody has published a mod here yet. The first one gets the Crash Landing badge.
profile_achievements_meta_description: How Survivor ranks, XP, creator tiers, badges and mod milestones work on SOTF Mods. Public rules that reward quality and help, not volume.
profile_achievements_intro: Every rule of the island’s rewards, in the open. They recognise quality and help, never raw volume.
profile_achievements_principle_quality: XP comes from helping others: useful reviews, accurate field reports and solved problems. Downloads never give XP.
profile_achievements_principle_no_streak: No daily streaks, no loot boxes and no leaderboards that shame anyone.
profile_achievements_principle_retroacti: Everything is retroactive: accounts from 2023 onwards keep what they already earned.
profile_achievements_principle_privacy: You can hide your rank and activity in your privacy settings.
profile_achievements_ranks_intro: Every member has a Survivor rank that grows with the XP earned by helping the community. It can’t be bought and it’s never lost for inactivity.
profile_achievements_xp_note: Actions on your own content don’t count. XP is audited and can be reversed if it came from abuse.
profile_xp_review_with_text: Review with at least 80 characters of text
profile_xp_compat_report: Field report (does it work on this build?)
profile_xp_compat_report_consensus: Bonus: your report matches the consensus after 72 h
profile_xp_comment_solution_or_pinned: Comment marked as the solution or pinned by the creator
profile_xp_bug_report_resolved: Bug report marked as resolved by the creator
profile_xp_first_follow: Follow your first mod or creator
profile_xp_patch_day_release: Creator: compatible version within 14 days of a breaking game update
profile_achievements_tiers_intro: Creators climb tiers automatically with the lifetime downloads of all their mods, history before v2 included. Each tier adds a stamp to the profile and a frame to the avatar.
profile_achievements_tier_perks_spotligh: Tier stamp, avatar frame and a spotlight on the home page.
profile_achievements_badges_intro: Badges fill each survivor’s field notebook. Locked ones show as dashed outlines with a hint, so you always know what’s next.
profile_achievements_badge_share: {share} of survivors · {count, plural, one {# holder} other {# holders}}
profile_achievements_milestones_intro: Every mod celebrates its download milestones, counted back to its first day. They appear as a timeline on the mod page and the biggest ones are announced on Discord.
profile_achievements_motw_body: Every Monday the mod with the strongest momentum among unique downloads wins, as long as it’s published, not broken on the current build and well rated. The same creator can’t win twice in a row within two weeks.
profile_achievements_day_body: Every profile shows how many days have passed since the account was created. Pure identity: it gives no points.
profile_achievements_fair_play_downloads: Downloads never give XP, so there’s nothing to gain from inflating them.
profile_achievements_fair_play_same_netw: Votes and reports between accounts on the same network within 24 hours don’t count.
profile_achievements_fair_play_new_accou: Brand-new accounts weigh half in ratings and compatibility until they build trust.
profile_achievements_fair_play_spikes: Sudden download spikes are reviewed by the Rangers.
profile_achievements_fair_play_reversibl: Every XP point is recorded and can be reversed if it came from abuse.
